title: parapolystichum pacificum
intro: Parapolystichum pacificum, commonly known as Pacific maidenhair fern, is a species of fern native to the Pacific coastal regions of North America. The Pacific maidenhair fern has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include its ability to treat respiratory issues, reduce inflammation, and act as an expectorant to relieve coughs. The therapeutic actions of Parapolystichum pacificum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the Pacific maidenhair fern include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
